title: Claude Code — Usage & Cost
description: Usage and cost for Claude Code through the apps gateway. Group by Okta group (user_groups, stamped by the gateway JWT), team, or cost_center (workstation OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES). Cumulative panels hold every in-range session's final contribution to the right edge; burn-rate panels show trailing-1h activity and drain within an hour of a session ending.

panels.title: Cost (selected range)

targets.expr: sum (((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[$__range]) - last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[7d] offset $__range)) >= 0) or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Total cost of all sessions seen in the selected range. Per session: counter peak minus its value at the range start when the session was already running (pre-range spend excluded; the baseline looks back up to 7d, so overnight/weekend-idle sessions do not re-count), else the full counter - so short/single-sample sessions still count. A session whose counter restarted from zero contributes its fresh counter until it overtakes the pre-reset value, then peak minus that value - an under-count of at most the pre-reset spend, never negative. Matches the right edge of the cumulative panels below.

panels.title: Tokens (selected range)

targets.expr: sum (((max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[$__range]) - last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[7d] offset $__range)) >= 0) or max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Total tokens of all sessions seen in the selected range; same per-session accounting as the cost tile.

panels.title: Sessions (selected range)
panels.description: Distinct sessions with any spend activity in the range. Counts unique session.id via count_over_time (sees single-sample and already-ended sessions). Counts one metric only: a multi-metric selector (__name__=~claude_code_.+) is INVALID here - range functions drop the metric name, so two metrics sharing a label set (one session's attribute-less counters) collide and the whole query errors.

panels.title: Active users (24h)
panels.description: Distinct users with any spend activity in 24h. Counts unique user_email over the window; robust to short/sparse sessions. One metric only - a multi-metric __name__ regex makes range functions emit colliding label sets and the query errors.

panels.title: Cost by team — cumulative (selected range)

targets.expr: sum by (team) ((((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[$__range]) - last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[7d] @ start())) >= 0) or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[$__range])) and count_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[$__range] @ end()))

panels.description: Running total across the selected range. Each session contributes its in-range rise (counter peak minus its value at the range start if it was already running; single-sample sessions count in full). A session that STARTED inside the range freezes at its final value when it stops reporting and holds to the right edge - flat means no new activity, not missing data. Sessions with NO samples inside the range (ended before it started) are excluded entirely. The range-start baseline looks back up to 7d, so a session left idle overnight or over a weekend resumes without re-counting its pre-range spend (idle >7d counts in full once); a session whose counter restarted from zero contributes its fresh counter until it overtakes the pre-reset value, then peak minus that value (an under-count of at most the pre-reset spend, with a one-time step down at the crossing; never negative). A pre-range session can show a mid-graph gap between its last old export sliding out of the lookback and its first new one; the RIGHT EDGE is always exact and matches the range tiles.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (user_email, team, cost_center) (((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[$__range]) - last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[7d] offset $__range)) >= 0) or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[$__range])))

panels.description: Top users by in-range cost; same per-session accounting as the 'Cost (selected range)' tile.

panels.title: Cost by team — burn rate (trailing 1h)

targets.expr: sum by (team) (max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[1h]) - min_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage{team=~"$team", cost_center=~"$cost_center", user_groups=~"$okta_group"}[1h]))

panels.description: Accrued in the trailing hour, per session then summed (max_over_time - min_over_time is each session's rise within the window; single-sample sessions contribute 0). A session that stops reporting drains out of this view within an hour - by design; the cumulative panels above hold totals to the right edge.
